body.statement: The stratified face/corner experiment has value \[\inf_{\eta\in\mathbb R}\inf_{\psi\in H^1(\mathbb R):\int\psi^2=1}\mathcal E_\eta(\psi)=\inf_{\psi:\int\psi^2=1}\int_{\mathbb R}\{4|\psi'(u)|^2+|u||\psi(u)|^2/2\}\,du=C_3.\] The least fiber is \(\eta=0\); \(\phi_3\) is its positive even ground state, satisfies \(\phi_3'(0)=0\), and has eigenvalue \(C_3=-a_1'\). Along the full integer sequence, the imported exact orbit games obey \[\rho_n^{\mathrm{all}}=\frac1n-C_3n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3}),\qquad \rho_n^{\mathrm{iid}}(q^\star)=\frac1n-C_3n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3}).\] Thus iid \(q^\star\) is second-order minimax and \(\rho_n^{\mathrm{iid}}(q^\star)-\rho_n^{\mathrm{all}}=o(n^{-4/3})\). The new assertion is the exact half-wedge constant and its uniform transfer through the singular labelled finite experiment; the orbit equality itself is inherited infrastructure.
body.justification: The theorem identifies the exact nonlinear gain from joint design and analysis and proves that a simple iid allocation attains the unrestricted benchmark to second order.
body.gap: Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen (2026, Theorem 3.1 and Appendix C) provide the one-dimensional Airy method, but their scalar lattice argument does not determine the three-arm half-wedge eigenvalue \(-a_1'\) or justify transfer through the coalesced transverse fiber.
body.consumer: For an active treatment compared with the equally weighted average of two binary comparators, the result supplies the sharp worst-case MSE benchmark and the exact magnitude of nonlinear improvement.
